Revisiting the vendor decision from last week. Used [[Inversion]] to ask "what would make us regret this choice in two years?" — surfaced three risks we hadn't talked about. Combined that with [[Probabilistic Thinking]] to weight the scenarios.

The more I use these models the more I appreciate [[Charlie Munger]]'s [[Latticework of Mental Models]] idea. No single model gives you the full picture.
